versions.changelog:
Version 2.0.0 — Major update introducing comprehensive modern web development best practices and standards.

- Added detailed guidance on KISS, DRY, and YAGNI principles for code quality.
- Expanded sections on TypeScript/JavaScript standards, including naming, immutability, error handling, async/await, and type safety.
- Introduced React patterns with typed components and custom hook examples.
- Provided a thorough code review self-checklist for consistency and quality.
- Included best practices for write-time quality enforcement: auto-formatting, pre-commit hooks, and integration with Claude Code sessions.
- Expanded security guidance on HTTPS, HSTS, Content Security Policy (CSP), and recommended web security headers.
